dimensions.name: Spec Format
dimensions.scoring_scale_ref: 90-100: hybrid MD+YAML with schema + examples. 60-89: structured MD with schema. 30-59: free MD. 0-29: ad-hoc prompts.

spec-kit.signal: Structured MD template with mandatory sections
spec-kit.value: User Stories P1/P2/P3 + FR-### + SC-### + Edge Cases + Assumptions + Key Entities
enforced in template + referenced in plan/tasks

get-shit-done.signal: Structured MD template with required fields
get-shit-done.value: Goal, Background, Requirements with Current/Target/Acceptance, Boundaries (in/out-of-scope), Constraints, Acceptance Criteria, Ambiguity Report

get-shit-done.signal: Quantitative gate before spec is locked

get-shit-done.value: 'The system should be fast' rejected in favour of '< 200ms at p95'

get-shit-done.signal: Related contracts (UI-SPEC, AI-SPEC) with own templates

superpowers.value: 'No Placeholders' rule in writing-plans (not at spec level)

justification.spec-kit: Four strong signals including stable IDs and per-spec validation checklist → high band.
justification.get-shit-done: Four strong signals including quantitative ambiguity gate; slightly below spec-kit because IDs are less canonically stable across artefacts.
justification.superpowers: By design no typed spec; scored mid-band because the brainstorming skill does capture design but without a schema.

dimensions.name: Traceability
dimensions.scoring_scale_ref: 90-100: IDs + bidirectional code↔spec↔test links. 60-89: spec→code. 30-59: only code tags. 0-29: none.

spec-kit.value: FR-001..N in spec, US# tags in tasks, plan.md references FR-###

spec-kit.signal: Issue export keeps IDs visible in external tracker
Plan template references spec by path

get-shit-done.signal: Verification reports map acceptance criteria to pass/fail

get-shit-done.value: tracks sources of claims through artefacts

superpowers.signal: TDD ties every behaviour to a test (implicit spec↔test link)
superpowers.value: every new function/method has a test — Verification Checklist in TDD skill

justification.spec-kit: Canonical ID scheme + external export → strong upper-60s/low-80s. Not 90+ because there's no continuous reverse link (code → FR-###).
justification.get-shit-done: Multiple gates + claim provenance, but IDs are not canonical.
justification.superpowers: No IDs, but tests function as traceability artefacts.

dimensions.name: Executable Specs
dimensions.scoring_scale_ref: 90-100: specs generate tests + scaffold + continuous validation. 60-89: specs generate tests. 30-59: specs generate scaffolding. 0-29: docs only.

spec-kit.signal: Tests are optional unless requested (weakens executable-spec claim)

superpowers.signal: Plan → fresh subagent per task + two-stage review is the execution engine
TDD mandates failing test first — closest thing in the trio to spec→test
No scaffolding of data-model/contracts from spec

justification.spec-kit: Widest scaffold surface, but the optional-tests default costs executable-spec points.
justification.get-shit-done: Multiple continuous gates + autonomous end-to-end → slight edge over spec-kit.
justification.superpowers: TDD + subagent review is close to executable, but no scaffolding of non-test artefacts.

dimensions.name: TDD Integration
dimensions.scoring_scale_ref: 90-100: enforcement + subagents + failing-tests-first. 60-89: recommended. 30-59: tests after code. 0-29: none.

spec-kit.value: 'only include them if explicitly requested in the feature specification'

spec-kit.signal: Acceptance scenarios exist in spec but are not mandatorily executed
spec-kit.value: User Stories specify Given/When/Then but tests are opt-in

superpowers.value: 'NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST' + 'Write code before the test? Delete it. Start over.'
'Verify RED' and 'Verify GREEN' are marked MANDATORY

justification.spec-kit: Explicit opt-out is documented — score deliberately low.
justification.get-shit-done: TDD as philosophy + gate, not as red-green enforcement.
justification.superpowers: Four strong signals including enforcement + subagent ordering → 90+ band.

dimensions.name: Roundtripping
dimensions.scoring_scale_ref: 90-100: bidirectional spec↔code + auto drift detection. 60-89: extraction OR drift detection. 30-59: manual sync. 0-29: spec goes stale.

spec-kit.signal: Consistency analyzer detects ambiguity/contradictions/gaps across spec/plan/tasks
Clarify loop resolves NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers

get-shit-done.signal: Schema drift gate blocks execute if ORM changes miss migrations

get-shit-done.value: 'state validate' detects drift; Sync reconstructs from disk

get-shit-done.signal: Codebase mapper seeds planning from existing code (closest thing to code→spec)

get-shit-done.value: continuous feedback loop into planning context

superpowers.signal: No drift detection or roundtripping skill

justification.spec-kit: On-demand consistency analysis is half the problem; no continuous loop or code→spec path.
justification.get-shit-done: Two drift-detection layers + codebase mapper → best of the trio, solidly in 60-89 band.

limitations: Pack weight for roundtripping (0.23) is the highest in the pack — this gives GSD's drift-detection an outsized effect on totals. If roundtripping weight were reduced to match spec_format/traceability (0.20), totals would shift 1–2 points but the ranking order would stay the same.

GitHub metrics (stars, contributors) were not retrieved from the web — scorecard relies on filesystem evidence only. This matches the local-first principle but means community health is not factored in.

Scores are calibrated against the pack's `scoring_scale` but bands still require human judgement on borderline values. Confidence reported is HIGH because every score has ≥2 evidence-linked signals (the one score ≥90 — superpowers on tdd_integration — has 4 signals).
